maxSteps.description: how many responses a sub-agent may make before it is asked for its report; default: no limit (it is still asked for its report near the context window)

instructions.description: give sub-agents the user and project instruction files (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md) the session loaded; false leaves them out

model.description: the model sub-agents use: a model saved by /model, or another model of the current service (for example a cheaper, faster one); default: the session's model

write.description: let sub-agents use every tool of the session, including ones that change files; their changes go through the same approval as the main agent's
